items.title: ERC-8499 讨论
items.note: 2026-11-15 16:05 作者 johba 回应：指纹定为账户 0 的 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s 公钥 SHA-256 前 4 字节（8 位十六进制），绝不直接从根或种子计算。服务器 CPU 上生成该密钥 72 ms，PBKDF2 为 3.6 ms，所以针对写下的指纹每次猜测的成本约为单纯 PBKDF2 的 20 倍；显示指纹仍为 SHOULD。有状态密钥部分写入：生成器的种子来源必须跨重启不重复，不能可靠保存状态的设备不得持有有状态实例。改动已进 ERCs PR #2172（2026-11-15 18:10 更新）。
items.note_en: At 16:05 on 2026-11-15 the author johba replied that the fingerprint is now fixed as the first 4 bytes of SHA-256 over account 0's SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s public key (8 hex digits), and is never computed from the root or a seed directly. On a server CPU that key generation took 72 ms against 3.6 ms for PBKDF2, so each guess against a written-down fingerprint costs about 20 times more than PBKDF2 alone. Showing it stays a SHOULD. For stateful keys, the draft now requires a generator seeded from a source that doesn't repeat across restarts, and says a device that can't keep state reliably must not hold a stateful instance. The changes are in ERCs PR #2172 (updated 18:10 on 2026-11-15).

items.title: Magicians：如何确认已部署合约仍运行审计过的代码
items.note: 2026-11-15 19:01，RealSpap（自称运营相关项目，披露可能有偏向）给出实测：同一个 Safe 地址 0xcBa28b38103307Ec8dA98377ffF9816C164f9AFa 在以太坊主网是 10 个签名者、门限 6，在 Base 主网是 9 个签名者、门限 5，并附可复现的 cast 命令。结论是同一地址不代表同一批签名者。
items.title_en: Magicians: checking that a deployed contract still runs the audited commit
items.note_en: At 19:01 on 2026-11-15, RealSpap (who runs a related project and disclosed possible bias) shared a measurement: the same Safe address 0xcBa28b38103307Ec8dA98377ffF9816C164f9AFa has 10 signers with a threshold of 6 on Ethereum mainnet, and 9 signers with a threshold of 5 on Base mainnet, with replayable cast commands. The takeaway: one shared address doesn't mean the same signers.

items.title: ERC 草案：同质化代币的受保护账户
items.note: 2026-11-15 18:59 有新回复，讨论测试用例。该草案（2026-11-07 发起）提出在 ERC-20 里加可选的“保护”标记：小额即时，大额排队并可由预设备用钱包取消，“stress”操作把余额转到备用钱包并锁定，可应对私钥被盗和胁迫。
items.title_en: Draft ERC: protected accounts for fungible tokens
items.note_en: A new reply at 18:59 on 2026-11-15 discussed test cases. The draft (opened 2026-11-07) adds an optional "protected" flag to ERC-20s: small sends stay instant, larger ones are queued and can be cancelled by a pre-registered backup wallet, and a "stress" action sweeps the balance to the backup and locks it, which helps against stolen keys and coercion.

items.title: ERC-8060（NFT 内嵌原生 ETH）讨论
items.note: 2026-11-16 08:10 更新：作者复现了“NFT 显示 1 ETH 但有 0.01 ETH 预留导致无法全额赎回”的情况，提出严格 ERC-8060 的 valueOf 必须等于可赎回金额，市场应在成交时原子检查预留状态。买这类 NFT 时不要只看挂单时的数值。
items.note_en: Updated at 08:10 on 2026-11-16: the author reproduced an NFT that reports 1 ETH of backing while a 0.01 ETH reservation blocks full redemption, and proposes that strict ERC-8060 valueOf must match what can actually be redeemed, with marketplaces checking reservation state atomically at settlement. When buying these NFTs, don't rely on the value shown at listing time.

summary_en: ACDT #103 meets at 21:00 tonight to present audit findings on the Glamsterdam repricing EIPs 8037 and 8038. Vitalik reposted a call for app developers to join, and Ethlabs recommends no decision until the impact is clear. On post-quantum accounts, ethresear.ch got its first app-side measurements: a Safe that only accepts hash-based signatures works with Permit2 but not with EIP-2612 permit, and ERC-8499 now derives the mnemonic fingerprint from a public key. The rest of Sunday was mostly ERC status moves and debate over the pqai27 timeline.
